## Upstream changes 0.40.15 -> 0.40.16

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — the notes describe new models and minor fixes only; the image configuration (user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck, environment) is unchanged between the two versions.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none

### Data and dependencies
- none. The notes mention no companion service version requirement (database, cache, search engine) for this range.

### Before applying
- No manual steps required. Routine update: bump `OLLAMA_IMAGE_VERSION` (or the pin in `x-images`) to `0.40.16` and pull.
- Optional sanity check after update: confirm `OLLAMA_MODEL_PREF` / `ANYTHINGLLM_CHAT_MODEL` still pulls and responds, since `/v1/models` behaviour changed slightly ("returns an empty list instead of `null` when no models are installed") — worth a quick look if anything downstream parses that endpoint directly, though AnythingLLM itself is not named in the notes as affected.

### Notes read
- v0.40.16 (2026-11-09) — upgrade target
- v0.40.15 (2026-11-03) — baseline, read only to confirm no requirement it states is being misattributed to this range

## Upstream changes 2026.11.0 -> 2026.11.1

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — a routine patch release of bug fixes and dependency bumps, with no breaking changes, no variable changes, and no companion-service version requirement introduced.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none

### Data and dependencies
- none. All version bumps listed (aiounifi, broadlink-async, opower, googlewifiapi, aioamazondevice, pylamarzocco, ZHA, pyvesync, holidays, xknx, zm-py, frontend, velbus-aio, aiovitesy, knx-frontend, aiowebostv, androidtvremote2, lorawan-connection, renault-api, aioswitcher, my-PV library, pyoverkiz, etc.) are Python library dependencies bundled inside the image for specific integrations, not externally-run companion services (database, cache, search engine). The compose file runs no such companion service tied to Home Assistant, so this does not touch the verdict rule.

### Before applying
- None required by the notes. Standard good practice still applies: the `backups` service in this template already takes a consistent SQLite copy and a data archive on its normal interval — confirm a recent backup exists before pulling the new digest, as with any update.

- 2026.11.1 (home-assistant/core release notes, full list above)
- 2026.11.0 (home-assistant/core release notes) — read only as the baseline per instructions; it contains no UPGRADING/BREAKING_CHANGES content, just a pointer to the monthly release post and changelog, so nothing from it carries forward as a requirement already in force.
